sloka: तम् रामः अभ्यपातत् क्षिप्रम् लक्ष्मणः च महा रथः ।विसम्ज्ञम् इव दुह्खेन सशोकम् नृपतिम् तदा ॥२-३४-१८॥
transliteration: tam rāmaḥ abhyapātat kṣipram lakṣmaṇaḥ ca mahā rathaḥ ।visamjñam iva duhkhena saśokam nṛpatim tadā ॥2-34-18॥

translations.english: Rama and the mighty warrior Lakshmana, quickly reached the king who lay as though he had lost his senses due to grief.
